name: eight-hour-block-hourly-spacing-band-020
rationale: Mandatory trading-cost hypothesis, second dose point for the 2026-10-10 lead #3. If 0.04 < 0.1 on Sharpe under the 8h/1h throttle, a 0.2 band (still below the ~0.25 lot floor at 50,000 JPY, so inert at the primary capital) maps the upper side of the band curve at 500,000 / 5,000,000 JPY and tells whether the optimum is a band so wide that only block-boundary target changes trade.
